title: docs(cli): document the cloud publish & install flow
body:
The CLI README documented `os init/compile/serve/...` but had **no** coverage of the cloud publish→install flow (`os cloud login`, `os package publish`, `os environments create`), and the Plugin Management note still pointed at the legacy `os projects bind` as the distribution path.

Adds a **Cloud — publish & install** section: login → publish → install-into-env with sample data, plus the key `os package publish` flags (`--env/--install/--seed-sample-data`, `--visibility`, `--submit/--auto-approve`, `OS_CLOUD_URL`). Updates the distribution note to point at `os package publish`.

Reflects the flow verified end-to-end against staging. Docs-only.
